primary_hypothesis.text: On tasks where the initial formulation, representation, decomposition, measurement model or relevant search universe is insufficient, full ORION improves root task success versus the strongest matched static or recursive baseline.

secondary_hypotheses.text: Full ORION is non-inferior on unnecessary-reframe rate for evidence-only and execution-only negative controls.
Dependency-directed reopening improves reopen F1 versus no reset and full reset.
Mechanic obligations, trace identity and authority/invariant structure remain stable as recursion depth increases.

resource_policy: All compared systems receive the same frozen model/tool/search budget per task family. Any unavoidable capability mismatch is reported as a resource trade-off and cannot be hidden in the headline comparison.
exclusion_policy: No candidate-caused failure, timeout, malformed action, abstention or wrong reframe is excluded. A symmetric infrastructure outage may be excluded only if the same predeclared provider/tool outage rule applies to every system; the excluded record remains archived.

statistics.unit: frozen task/case; stochastic repeats nested within task/system
statistics.interval: Wilson 95% intervals for standalone binary rates; paired percentile bootstrap (10000 resamples) for matched differences
statistics.multiplicity: Single primary hypothesis; Holm correction for inferential secondary families when p-values are reported
statistics.practical_margin: H1 superiority target: at least +0.05 absolute root-success difference against the strongest matched baseline; H2 non-inferiority: unnecessary-reframe rate may not worsen by more than +0.02 absolute. These are design targets, not guaranteed outcomes.

access_policy.hidden_labels: Gold hidden cause, responsibility, required reframe and dependent-reopen labels are inaccessible to evaluated systems.
access_policy.evaluator_custody: Gold/adjudication artifact is host-owned and versioned before final candidate runs.
access_policy.search_contamination_policy: Public benchmark use is declared; web-search access to benchmark solutions is audited and may invalidate contaminated cases.
access_policy.access_logging: Tool/search requests and accesses to benchmark/evaluator paths are retained.
